title: Immortal Shadow in Talisman
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji and Ye Qing were gazing at the line of mysterious ancient script, a blinding sword light suddenly swept across the distant horizon—that was the unique Void-Cutting Sword Intent of the Tianqing Sect, and the newcomer meant trouble.

text.content: The runes at the core of the formation suddenly illuminated, like an ancient lake dormant for millennia disturbed by a pebble. Chen Ji felt intense pain in his Brow Center, and the Tianji Record Fragment began operating on its own, emanating a desolate and remote aura that resonated with some mysterious force within the formation. "This is..." His voice trembled slightly, yet he forcibly steadied his mind, pouring all his attention into tracing the trajectory of those ancient runes, attempting to seize the fleeting profound mechanism.

At this moment, at the deepest part of the formation, a faint, ethereal figure gradually coalesced. It was a white-haired elder, clad in an ancient immortal robe that had long been lost to history, surrounded by tiny fragments of spiritual energy resembling scattered starlight. His gaze was hollow yet profound, as if capable of penetrating endless Void. Upon seeing Chen Ji, his withered lips actually trembled slightly. "This aura..." The elder's voice seemed to have traversed ten thousand years, carrying the vicissitudes and exhaustion of time, "Is this the disciple of an old friend?"

dialogue.content: "Does the senior know my master?" Chen Ji suppressed the tumultuous waves in his heart, maintaining an unruffled exterior. While saluting with respect, he had already收敛 the aura of the Tianji Record to its lowest. Mo Xiansheng on that fragment had never mentioned such an existence—now he had no choice but to be cautious. Who knew whether this immortal's remnant was friend or foe?

text.content: A flickering light seemed to glow in the immortal's remnant's hollow eye sockets—that was an obsession burning across countless ages. "Know him? The karma from ten thousand years ago cannot be summarized by merely saying 'know'." He let out a soft sigh, carrying inexplicable complex emotions. "This old one has been trapped in this formation for over three thousand years, yet I never expected to meet an inheritor of the Tianji Record at the end of my life."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply. A being from ten thousand years ago? A three-thousand-year trapped formation? This information exploded in her mind like thunder. As a Holy Demon Sect Saint, she prided herself on having seen much, yet such ancient secrets were completely unheard of. What alarmed her even more was Chen Ji's reaction—beneath that seemingly calm face, how much did he hide that she didn't know?

text.content: "Since the senior is an old friend, why are you trapped in this formation as a remnant soul?" Chen Ji keenly captured the crucial information. Mo Xiansheng's form of existence was identical to this one before him—both remnant souls dwelling within objects. What was the connection between them? His intuition told him that this ancient immortal's remnant soul knew certain truths capable of overturning all understanding.

dialogue.content: The immortal's remnant emitted a sound somewhere between crying and laughing, the ethereal figure slightly distorting. "Because this old one attempted to break the 'Heavenly Fate Shackles', I was counterattacked by Heavenly Dao and trapped in this formation for ten thousand years without release." He paused, his gaze falling upon the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hands. "Since you have inherited this item, you must have sensed it—every glimpse into Heavenly Secrets comes at the price of destiny's power."

text.content: This statement was like a blade,狠狠刺入 Chen Ji's heart. Heavenly Fate—that was precisely what he had always deliberately avoided yet couldn't escape facing. Every glimpse into the next three hours consumed five points of Heavenly Fate, and over these years, how much had he actually consumed? Now hearing this ancient immortal confirm it personally, his shock was beyond words.

dialogue.content: "So the method to break this formation..." Chen Ji's voice turned hoarse—he had already guessed the answer yet still clung to a sliver of hope. The immortal's remnant saw through his thoughts, and a bitter smile appeared on that illusory face. "Correct—this formation requires destiny's power as the catalyst. In other words, every Heavenly Fate Value you consume when using the Tianji Record is precisely the key to unlocking these shackles."

text.content: A deathly silence filled the formation. Ye Qing stared intently at Chen Ji's profile, attempting to read more information from it. She suddenly realized that this seemingly worthless Servant Disciple was probably never a pushover from the start. Tianji Record, destiny's power, Heavenly Fate Value—these words connected, outlining a grand scheme far beyond her imagination.

choice.prompt: Facing the truth revealed by the immortal's remnant, how should Chen Ji make his choice?

choices.description: Since breaking the formation requires consuming Heavenly Fate Value, then forcibly deduce the weaknesses using the Tianji Record, trading fate for a chance of survival. This is the most direct path, yet it means completely exposing the existence of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the complete method to break the formation
choices.risk_hint: When Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero, one will suffer Heavenly Dao's backlash, and exposing the Tianji Record's existence may invite greater crises

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, a hint of determination flickering in his eyes. "Since the senior has pointed out this path, the junior will take the gamble." He slowly unfurled the Tianji Record Fragment, and on its yellowed surface, countless mysterious runes began flowing on their own, emanating a terrifying pressure.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing couldn't help but step back two paces—that pressure caused even her Demonic Path mist to tremble slightly. "Are you insane?" she whispered, her eyes full of disbelief. This seemingly cowardly wretch actually dared to fully activate that Tianji Record at this moment?

choices.description: Without directly consuming Heavenly Fate Value, instead use Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist to conceal aura, attempting to break the formation through external force. Lower risk, but may miss the opportunity to obtain crucial truths.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming Ye Qing's spiritual power reserves
choices.visible_reward: Preserving the Tianji Record's secret and retaining Heavenly Fate Value
choices.risk_hint: External force may not completely break the formation, and may miss subsequent information the immortal's remnant might reveal
choices.process_label: use demonic mist to break formation

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips. "Gambling on Heavenly Fate? How foolish." He turned to look at Ye Qing. "Can Your Holiness Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist conceal this formation's perception? Let's try to break the formation with force."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing narrowed her eyes, studying Chen Ji for a moment before letting out a light laugh. "Interesting." As she raised her hand, dense black mist surged from her fingertips, enveloping the two of them. "Since it's come to this, this Holy Maiden shall accompany you in this madness."

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently in Chen Ji's palm, the ancient runes seeming to come alive as they danced across the paper's surface. His consciousness was pulled into a chaotic Void, countless images flickering past like a carousel—the formation's veins, breakthrough paths, hidden dangers... Yet just as he was about to grasp the crucial information, a blurred figure suddenly intruded into his vision.

The figure was shrouded in a hazy glow, its features indiscernible, yet evoking an inexplicable sense of familiarity in Chen Ji. The Tianji Record's divination halted abruptly at that silhouette, the images fragmenting into an indistinct blur. "This is..." Chen Ji felt a sudden shock, recalling the Tianji Record's characteristic of being unable to divine certain specific individuals. A being capable of disrupting the Tianji Record—perhaps only one such existence exists in all the world...

dialogue.content: "Senior!" Chen Ji abruptly lifted his head, his voice carrying a hint of urgency. "You just mentioned twin fates and bloodline resonance—could this 'bloodline resonant' individual be related to me by blood?" The ethereal remnant of the immortal had faded to near transparency, yet upon hearing these words, an unusual glint flickered in those vacant eye sockets.

text.content: The immortal's remnant hung like a candle flame in the wind, perpetually on the verge of vanishing. Gazing at Chen Ji, an expression of indistinguishable relief or sorrow surfaced on that weathered face. "Heaven's cycles turn, karma remains unfailing..." his voice gradually softened, drifting from an immense distance. "Twin fates intertwined, blood resonance awakens, the key finally emerges—your sister is the crux of all."

The instant the words fell, the immortal's remnant completely dissolved, transforming into scattered starlight that merged into the formation. Those previously cryptic symbols suddenly clarified, with countless mysterious trajectories weaving together before Chen Ji's eyes into a comprehensive formation diagram. He discerned—the formation's core wasn't the complex restrictions, but a barely perceptible fissure, which was precisely the key to breaking it.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing watched the starlight dissipate, her expression intricate. Though she hadn't caught the entire dialogue, the words "sister" and "key" were sufficient for her to deduce much. "You've been searching for someone?" Her voice carried no emotional fluctuation, purely stating a fact. "And that person seems profoundly connected to both this formation and your Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji offered no response, silently gazing at the faintly discernible fissure at the formation's core. Ye Qing's assessment was accurate—he had indeed been searching for Chen Nian. Yet over these years, no matter how many times he divined, images of his sister remained blurred, as if deliberately obscured by something. Hearing the immortal remnant's words now, a sudden realization struck him—the Tianji Record wasn't weak; rather, Chen Nian herself embodied the very power capable of disrupting Heavenly Secrets.

choice.prompt: The formation's weakness has appeared—how should Chen Ji act?

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot,灌注spiritual energy至裂缝中 now to thoroughly break the formation. Fast speed, but may trigger hidden mechanisms due to insufficient preparation.
choices.visible_reward: Immediately obtain the complete inheritance within the formation
choices.risk_hint: The formation trapped the immortal remnant for three thousand years—there must be hidden mechanisms within
choices.process_label: pour power to break seal core

text.content: "No more waiting." Chen Ji's eyes flashed with brilliant light as he formed seals with both hands, Spiritual Energy surging toward that fissure like a tide. The formation let out a mournful tremor, countless runes beginning to collapse.

Yet just as the formation was about to break but hadn't fully broken, a boundless force suddenly erupted from the fissure, rushing straight toward Chen Ji's face. His pupils contracted sharply as he暴退, yet he was still grazed by that force on his shoulder, blood instantly staining his robes crimson. "Cough..." He groaned, yet forcibly swallowed the blood rising in his throat.

choices.description: First deploy isolation formations using Demonic Path mist, then slowly study the formation's structure. Time-consuming, but can maximize risk avoidance and ensure safe acquisition of the inheritance.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a great deal of time
choices.visible_reward: Safely obtain the inheritance, preserving complete intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from other covetous individuals

text.content: "Wait." Chen Ji raised his hand to halt Ye Qing's movements, a contemplative gleam flickering in his eyes. "This formation trapped the immortal remnant for three thousand years—who knows what hidden mechanisms lie within. Let's first set up isolation formations to completely conceal the aura here, then study it slowly."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, yet offered no objection. With a wave of her hand, Demonic Path mist spread like silk threads, constructing layers of concealed barriers around the two of them. "Your cautious nature is quite like that of an old fox," she commented with a half-smile. "Not like that impulsive waste."

text.content: The formation finally collapsed completely, countless points of light scattering like fireflies through the air, illuminating this dark subterranean space like a dream. Chen Ji stood motionless, watching those gradually dissipating lights, his heart filled with countless emotions. The immortal remnant's parting words still echoed in his ears—twin fates, bloodline resonance, the key finally emerges. Chen Nian, where exactly are you?

Ye Qing put away the Demonic Path mist and walked to Chen Ji's side. She didn't speak, just quietly watched those drifting light specks, as if she too was contemplating something. After a long while, she finally spoke, her voice carrying a rare hint of seriousness: "Your sister... I'll help you find her." Such simple words made Chen Ji pause slightly. When did this Demonic Path Saint start willingly entangling herself in his karma?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Ye Qing, his gaze deep as an abyss. "What does the Ye Saint mean by this? Between us, it's merely a transactional relationship. If you get too deeply involved, you might bring trouble upon yourself." His voice carried no emotional fluctuation, cold to the point of ruthlessness. Yet Ye Qing caught a subtle wave in his eyes—perhaps this seemingly heartless man wasn't as cold on the inside as he appeared on the surface.

Ye Qing let out a light laugh, carrying an indescribable meaning. "Transaction? Chen Ji, we both know that once certain things begin, no one gets to choose." She turned and walked deeper into the passage, her voice ethereal as wind: "Twin fates, blood resonance—these words weren't mine to speak. Since our fates have already intertwined, let me see just how far this chess game of yours can go."

text.content: Staring at Ye Qing's departing figure, Chen Ji remained motionless for a long time. The remnants of the talisman formation's collapse still lingered in the air, that desolate and distant aura gradually fading away. He lowered his gaze to his palm, where the Tianji Record Fragment lay quietly, its surface markings even dimmer than before—these two divinations had cost him quite a bit of Heavenly Fate. However, more significant than these losses were the revelations hinted at by the Immortal's remnant will.

Chen Nian. Heavenly Fate Lock Key. The Shackles of Destiny. These three keywords spiraled endlessly in his mind, connecting countless fragmented clues. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned any of this, yet that predecessor who had trapped the Immortal's remnant will for three thousand years had spoken of the profound secrets in a single phrase. There seemed to be some truth between the inheritors of the Tianji Record that he had yet to grasp. And that truth might be even more important than the inheritance within this formation.

Just then, a slight tremor suddenly came from deep within the passage. Chen Ji's brow furrowed as he looked up to see a blinding sword light streaking across the distant horizon. The sword intent was凌厉无匹, carrying an earth-shattering pressure as it raced toward them. The Void-Piercing Sword Intent of the Tianqing Sect—with hostile intentions!

A cold gleam flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, yet his expression remained composed. He tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his chest, straightened his clothes, and reassumed that weak and easily bullied demeanor. No matter who was coming, his persona as the "useless servant disciple" could not crumble. With Ye Qing lurking in the shadows, that uninvited guest was about to be disappointed. He leisurely walked toward the passage entrance, a subtle arc curving at the corner of his lips. "Come then," he thought, "let's see who dares to be so careless."
